notes.title: PROGRESS REPORT
notes.content: [h2]🐑 SHEEP Progress Update[/h2][p]Final dev route is locked in! Feels good to see the remaining journey mapped out. Here’s where I’m at right now:[/p][list][*][p]SFX & music: about 80% done, the world feels alive.[/p][/*][*][p]Programming: 85%, most systems are solid and I’m ironing out the last bits.[/p][/*][*][p]LODs & profiling: 85%, the game is running beautifully across a good range of hardware.[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue: 90%, nearly all the writing’s in place.[/p][/*][*][p]Menus: 100%, those are wrapped up and working.[/p][/*][/list][p]Things are really coming together and the finish line’s finally in sight. For those of you who’ve kept an eye on [i]SHEEP[/i] along the way, I appreciate you sticking around. More soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576765/f56cd1548ab335073062145d610559a19be6b132.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Audio update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576765/f2c54c8cb1e88d1317230084cb77d972b3ce73bd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’ve just updated the demo to include full sound effects and audio. This means you can finally experience the demo with all the atmosphere, cues, and feedback we intended.[/p][p]We’d love to hear what you think—especially how the sound changes the feel of the game![/p][p]Thanks for playing and for all your feedback so far.[/p][p]— B[/p]
